## ArcVault intake & triage
**1 Ingest** webhook  ->  **2 Classify** (LLM)  ->  **3 Enrich + summary** (LLM)  ->  **4-6 Route, escalate, build record** (plain code, no LLM)  ->  deliver to queue + return JSON

- LLM: Groq `llama-3.3-70b-versatile`, temperature 0, JSON mode
- Escalate if confidence < 0.70, Incident/Outage, escalation phrase, or billing discrepancy > $500
- Setup: create a **Header Auth** credential `Groq API` (Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer <key>`) and select it on both LLM nodes; paste your webhook.site URL into both Deliver nodes.
